cover.desc: Full color, warm domestic light. A cramped apartment kitchen in late morning. Kou stands at the stove in a plain t-shirt with a tea towel over one shoulder, black hair, sleeves shoved up, bandaged left forearm, entirely absorbed in a pan. Kanade leans against the counter beside him in weekend clothes, pale silver hair loose over one shoulder, holding a spoon in both hands with the focused expression of somebody performing a serious duty. Steam between them. Flat pastel palette, cream and pale blue, one warm shaft of window light, generous negative space above.

panels.bg: small apartment interior, morning light through thin curtains, tidy, sparse, one shelf of neatly labelled containers
panels.action: Saturday. Nine forty. Nothing is happening.

dialogue.text: Saturday.
Two rooms, one window, and a sister who works nights.
Saturdays are for stocktake and sleeping wrong.

chars.name: kou
chars.pose: sitting on the floor against the wall, phone in one hand

panels.bg: apartment wall, futon folded beside him, tone-washed
panels.action: His phone has been going for eleven minutes.

dialogue.text: ARE YOU AWAKE
You're awake. You've read it. I can SEE that you've read it.
I'm awake.

chars.name: gen
chars.pose: chibi, clutching phone with both hands

panels.action: Gen's side of the conversation, in full.

dialogue.text: COME OUT. It's SATURDAY. People go OUTSIDE on Saturday.
I go outside.
TO THE STOREROOM.

chars.name: kou
chars.pose: thumb over the screen, not typing

panels.action: He types nothing for a while.

dialogue.text: He does this every Saturday and I say no every Saturday.
It's been two years. He hasn't got bored of it.
Busy today. Sorry.

chars.name: kou
chars.pose: head turning toward a knock

panels.bg: apartment, front door in frame, tone-washed
panels.action: Somebody knocks. Nobody knocks.

dialogue.text: Nobody knocks here.
The landlord posts things. Gen texts for an hour first.

chars.name: kanade
chars.pose: standing in the corridor holding two full paper bags of groceries

panels.bg: apartment block corridor, concrete, daylight from the stairwell, tone-washed
panels.action: First in the year, on his landing, carrying shopping.

dialogue.text: Good morning.
...It's Saturday.
I'm aware of the day, Hazama. I own a calendar.

chars.name: kanade
chars.pose: shifting a bag higher on her hip

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: blank, hand still on the door
chars.pose: not moving out of the doorway

panels.action: She has clearly rehearsed a reason and does not use it.

dialogue.text: You said you cook. On Wednesday. You said it like it was nothing.
It is nothing.
Then it won't be a problem to demonstrate.

chars.name: kou
chars.pose: looking at the bags, then at her

panels.action: He does the arithmetic on the bags.

dialogue.text: That's four days of food.
She doesn't know what things cost. She has never once had to know.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: faltering under the silence, recovering badly
chars.pose: eyes anywhere but on him

panels.action: The silence goes on one second too long and she fills it.

dialogue.text: You can say no. I'll take it home.
It'll go off in my room and I'll deserve it.
Ariake.
What.

chars.name: kou
chars.pose: holding the door open

chars.name: kanade
chars.pose: walking in past him

panels.bg: genkan, shoes lined up neatly, tone-washed
panels.action: He moves out of the doorway. That's the entire negotiation.

dialogue.text: Shoes off.
Obviously.
Thirteen months and I've never seen her ask for anything.

chars.name: shizu
chars.pose: standing in the kitchen doorway in a lab coat over pyjama trousers, mug in hand

chars.name: kanade
chars.pose: bowing slightly, bags still in her arms

panels.bg: small kitchen, drying rack, one window, tone-washed
panels.action: His sister has been awake for eleven minutes and has already assessed the situation.

dialogue.text: There's a girl in the kitchen.
There is.
All right.

chars.name: kanade
chars.pose: straightening, hands at her sides

chars.name: shizu
chars.pose: leaning on the doorframe

panels.action: Kanade deploys the assembly voice and it is far too much for a kitchen.

dialogue.text: Ariake Kanade. I'm in your brother's year. Thank you for having me.
I'm not having you. I'm going to sleep.

chars.name: kanade
chars.pose: chibi, rigid, sweating

chars.name: shizu
chars.pose: chibi, drinking

panels.action: Comedy spike.

dialogue.text: I've offended her. Nine seconds. New record.
She talks to me like that too.
I talk to everyone like that.

chars.name: shizu
chars.pose: pausing in the doorway, half turned

panels.action: She stops on her way out.

dialogue.text: He'll cook for you. He's good at it.
Tell him if it's right. He can't check.

chars.name: kanade
chars.pose: standing with the bags, not putting them down

chars.name: kou
chars.pose: taking a bag from her arms

panels.action: Shizu is gone. The sentence stays in the room.

dialogue.text: She just says it. Like the weather.
Don't. She's not being sad at you. That's just information.

chars.name: kou
chars.pose: at the counter, sleeves up, chopping fast and precisely

chars.name: kanade
chars.pose: sitting on the counter edge, legs crossed

panels.action: He is very fast and very good and it is annoying to watch.

dialogue.text: Where did you learn to do that?
Mio was six and somebody had to.
That's not an answer about knives.

chars.name: kou
chars.pose: hands on the board, not looking up

panels.action: He answers the question she actually asked.

dialogue.text: Book from the library. Then a different book. Then it was just what I did.
You taught yourself out of a library book at eleven.
It's not interesting.

chars.name: kanade
chars.pose: swinging one foot, elbow on knee

panels.action: She has found a new lever and is going to pull it repeatedly.

dialogue.text: It's extremely interesting. You're the worst-dressed person in our year.
Thank you.
And you own a proper knife. You have a WHETSTONE.

chars.name: kou
chars.pose: levelling a spoon of salt against the rim of a jar

panels.bg: counter, pan on the stove, steam, tone-washed
panels.action: He measures everything. Nothing is done by eye.

dialogue.text: Why are you weighing that.
Because it's the only way to know.

panels.bg: flat tone field, a levelled measuring spoon and an open notebook of handwritten timings, tone-washed
panels.action: The notebook is full. Years of it, in his terrible handwriting.

dialogue.text: Four minutes. Then two. Half a spoon, levelled, never heaped.
You don't need to taste anything if you never change the numbers.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: the delight going out of her face
chars.pose: sitting very still on the counter, holding the notebook

chars.name: kou
chars.pose: at the stove

panels.action: She has understood the notebook and he has not noticed her go quiet.

dialogue.text: Hazama. This is a control experiment.
It's a recipe.
It's four years of one recipe with the variables removed.

chars.name: kou
chars.pose: shoulder half turned toward her

panels.action: He says it the way he says everything.

dialogue.text: Taste went at layer four. Two years ago, near enough.
So I stopped guessing and started measuring. It works.

chars.name: kanade
chars.pose: looking at the pan, not at him

panels.action: She is not going to say anything kind. She has worked out that kind would be the wrong shape.

dialogue.text: He'd hate it. Say the wrong thing and he'll do the mild voice.
So don't be sorry at him. Be useful at him.

chars.name: kanade
chars.pose: holding out one hand, palm up

panels.action: She holds out her hand for the spoon.

dialogue.text: Give me the spoon.
It's fine. The numbers are—
Hazama. Give me the spoon.

panels.bg: flat tone field, a wooden spoon passing from one hand to another over steam, tone-washed
panels.action: He gives her the spoon. Two hands, one spoon, no comment.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: eyes closed, absolute concentration, taking it entirely seriously
chars.pose: tasting from the spoon with both hands around it

panels.bg: kitchen, warm steam, soft bokeh, tone-washed
panels.action: She tastes it like an examination she intends to come first in.

dialogue.text: She's doing it like it's an assessment.

chars.name: kanade
chars.pose: lowering the spoon

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: waiting, more interested than he wants to be
chars.pose: hand on the pan handle

panels.action: The verdict.

dialogue.text: It's under-salted. Slightly. And there's not enough of the sharp thing.
Vinegar.
Then more vinegar. Half again.

chars.name: kou
chars.pose: spoon halfway to the pan

panels.action: He stops with the spoon in the air.

dialogue.text: The numbers have been the same for two years.
The numbers are the only reason it's ever been right.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: waiting, hands behind her back, saying nothing
chars.pose: standing very deliberately still

panels.action: She waits. She has learned to wait, once, four days ago, and it worked.

dialogue.text: Don't help. Don't arrange it. Just stand here.

chars.name: kou
chars.pose: tipping the spoon into the pan

panels.action: He changes the number.

dialogue.text: Now stir it and count to twenty.
You have never cooked anything in your life.
No. But I can taste it, and you can cook it.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: second taste, eyebrows going up, genuinely surprised
chars.pose: spoon at her mouth, eyes widening

panels.bg: kitchen, warm light, sparkle tone, tone-washed
panels.action: The second taste.

dialogue.text: Oh.
Oh, that's — that's completely different.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: watching her face with total attention
chars.pose: still, hand on the counter

panels.action: He is not looking at the pan.

dialogue.text: I can't check it. I'll never be able to check it.
But I can see her face, and her face is not being polite.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: businesslike, hiding how pleased she is
chars.pose: pointing the spoon at him like a baton

chars.name: kou
chars.pose: arms folded

panels.action: She institutes a system, because that is what she does with everything.

dialogue.text: Right. New rule. You cook it, I taste it, you fix it.
That's a rota.
It's a rota. Saturdays. Write it in the book.

panels.bg: flat tone field, the open notebook, a line being added in terrible handwriting under years of neat timings, tone-washed
panels.action: He writes it in the book. It is the first line in four years that is not a number.

dialogue.text: Vinegar: half again. (K.)

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: reading over his shoulder, going still
chars.pose: leaning in

panels.action: She sees the initial and says nothing about it, which takes everything she has.

dialogue.text: He put a letter in it.
Don't say anything. Don't you dare say anything.

chars.name: gen
chars.pose: standing in the open doorway with a bag of crisps, frozen mid-arrival

chars.name: riko
chars.expression: small round glasses catching the light, deeply suspicious
chars.pose: half behind him, tablet under one arm

panels.action: The door was not locked. It has never needed to be locked.

dialogue.text: I brought crisps and moral supp—
ARIAKE-SAN IS IN YOUR KITCHEN.
Ariake-san is in his kitchen.

chars.name: gen
chars.pose: chibi, orbiting the room

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: dot eyes, rigid, spoon still in hand
chars.pose: chibi, statue-still

panels.bg: blank background, chaos lines, starburst screentone
panels.action: Full comedy spike.

dialogue.text: HOW LONG. HOW LONG HAS THIS BEEN HAPPENING.
Forty minutes.
THAT IS A HORRIBLE ANSWER AND I HATE IT.

chars.name: riko
chars.pose: arms folded, looking at the counter

chars.name: kanade
chars.pose: putting the spoon down with great care

panels.action: Riko is not looking at the two of them. She is looking at the shopping.

dialogue.text: You bought four days of food for a lunch.
I bought what was on the list.
There wasn't a list. You don't write lists.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: smiling pleasantly, eyes not in it
chars.pose: half turned away

panels.action: The committee smile arrives on schedule.

dialogue.text: Riko. Sit down and eat something.
That's the assembly voice. In a kitchen.

chars.name: kou
chars.pose: reaching past both of them for the cupboard

panels.action: He defuses it the only way he knows.

dialogue.text: There's enough for four. Sit down.
FOUR. HE SAID FOUR.

chars.name: kou
chars.pose: sitting on the floor at a low table

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: arguing cheerfully with her mouth full
chars.pose: cross-legged, gesturing with chopsticks

chars.name: gen
chars.pose: sprawled, bowl balanced on one knee

chars.name: riko
chars.pose: kneeling, tablet abandoned beside her

panels.bg: small apartment room, low table, four bowls, late morning light across the floor, tone-washed with soft warm gradient
panels.action: Four people eating on the floor of a two-room flat. Nothing else happens for a while.

dialogue.text: This is the best thing I have ever eaten in this building.
You've eaten here twice.
And it was the best BOTH times.
The vinegar was my contribution.
She put in half again.
Nobody in this room knows what any of us do on Thursdays.
Hazama-kun. Did you make the stock as well?
On Wednesday. It keeps four days.
...He makes stock on Wednesdays.
HE MAKES STOCK ON WEDNESDAYS.
Stop shouting and pass the bowl.
I will never stop shouting. This is a historic day.

chars.name: riko
chars.expression: watching, glasses down, quietly working something out
chars.pose: chin on her hand

chars.name: kanade
chars.pose: leaning back on her hands

panels.action: Riko has known her for six years and has never seen this.

dialogue.text: I have known Kanade since we were eleven.
I have never once seen her sit on a floor.

chars.name: riko
chars.pose: looking across at Kou's forearm

panels.action: She sees the bandage. She has seen it every day for two years.

dialogue.text: And she is looking at that boy's arm every four minutes.

chars.name: gen
chars.pose: pointing at Kou with his chopsticks

panels.action: Gen investigates nothing and improves everything.

dialogue.text: You didn't come to the arcade for TWO YEARS and now there are PEOPLE here.
They let themselves in.
I'm so proud of you.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: the mild face holding, eyes lowering a fraction
chars.pose: looking into his bowl

panels.action: The one that gets through.

dialogue.text: He's proud of me for having lunch.
He'd forgive the whole thing in four seconds if I told him. That's why I can't.

chars.name: riko
chars.pose: sliding the door open

panels.action: Riko leaves early and says one thing on the way out.

dialogue.text: Kanade. Whatever it is, be careful with it.
With what?
Mm.

chars.name: shizu
chars.expression: flat, awake now, drying a bowl
chars.pose: at the sink in the lab coat

chars.name: kanade
chars.pose: holding a plate and a cloth

panels.bg: kitchen at the sink, afternoon light, tone-washed
panels.action: The washing up. Gen and Kou are audible in the next room, arguing about a game.

dialogue.text: You changed one of his numbers.
The vinegar.
He hasn't changed a number in two years. I've watched him not do it.

chars.name: kanade
chars.pose: drying the same plate twice

panels.action: She asks the question she has been carrying since the doorway.

dialogue.text: Hazama-san. May I ask what your count is?
Fourteen.

chars.name: shizu
chars.pose: stacking a bowl

panels.action: She recites it like a form she has filled in many times.

dialogue.text: Taste, smell, hot, cold, pain, grip, weather, startle.
Then funny. Then wanting things. That was thirteen.

chars.name: kanade
chars.pose: gripping the cloth

panels.action: Kanade does not ask what fourteen was.

dialogue.text: Don't ask. Don't ask what fourteen was.

chars.name: shizu
chars.expression: nothing, looking at her hands in the water
chars.pose: standing at the sink

panels.action: She answers it anyway, because it is only information.

dialogue.text: Fourteen was being able to want things.
I still do the dishes. It's what I would have wanted to do.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: standing very straight, face doing nothing, eyes wrong
chars.pose: on a narrow concrete balcony, hands on the rail

panels.bg: apartment balcony, laundry pole, low rooftops, afternoon sky, tone-washed
panels.action: She came out for air and has been out here eleven minutes.

dialogue.text: Nine. He's on nine. She was on nine once too.
Thirteen months I've dived with him.
I have never once done this arithmetic.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: mild, two mugs in his hands
chars.pose: stepping out through the balcony door

panels.action: He comes out with tea and does not ask what's wrong.

dialogue.text: She told you the list.
She did.
She tells everyone. It isn't a warning. It's just what she has.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: taking the mug, holding it in both hands
chars.pose: turning to face out over the rail

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: beside her, not looking at her
chars.pose: elbows on the rail

panels.action: They stand next to each other and look at some roofs.

dialogue.text: Can you feel that? The mug.
I can feel that I'm holding it. Not that it's hot.

chars.name: kanade
chars.pose: looking down into the mug

panels.action: She decides to be useful instead of sorry. Again.

dialogue.text: Then I'll tell you. It's very hot. Almost too hot to hold properly.
And it's cold out here. Properly cold, not fresh. Your ears would hurt.

chars.name: kou
chars.pose: mug halfway to his mouth

panels.action: Nobody has ever done this.

dialogue.text: Two years and nobody has ever just told me.
They apologise, or they forget. Nobody describes it.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: brisk, embarrassed, covering it with efficiency
chars.pose: gesturing at the street below with her mug

chars.name: kou
chars.pose: leaning on the rail beside her

panels.bg: balcony over a small street, tone-washed
panels.action: She keeps going, because stopping would mean acknowledging she started.

dialogue.text: The tea is grassy. Slightly bitter at the end, which is a fault.
The lunch was salty and sharp and the sharp arrived second.
You're doing an inventory.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: defensive, going red at the ears
chars.pose: shoulders up

panels.action: Caught.

dialogue.text: It's a system. Systems are efficient.
I didn't say stop.

chars.name: kanade
chars.pose: chibi, both hands over her face

chars.name: kou
chars.pose: chibi, unbothered

panels.action: She retreats into cartoon for exactly one panel.

dialogue.text: I AM DESCRIBING TEA TO A BOY ON A BALCONY.
You're doing it well.
THAT IS WORSE.

chars.name: kou
chars.pose: hands around the mug

panels.action: He gives her something back, which he never does.

dialogue.text: I remember that melon bread was good.
I remember the fact. I don't remember the good.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: not making a face, holding it together deliberately
chars.pose: looking straight ahead

panels.action: She does not do a thing with her face. It costs her everything, again.

dialogue.text: Don't. He hates it. Don't you dare do the face.
It's sweet. Melon bread. Sweet, and the top goes crisp.

chars.name: gen
chars.pose: at the front door, hopping into a shoe

chars.name: kou
chars.pose: hand on the doorframe

panels.action: Gen leaves at four and says the thing on the step.

dialogue.text: Same time next Saturday?
I've got stocktake.
Yeah. I know. I ask anyway.
One of these years you'll say yes and I'll fall over.
Mind the step, then.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: the mild face slipping for one panel
chars.pose: standing in the doorway after he's gone

panels.action: One panel where the face isn't working.

dialogue.text: He asks anyway. Every week. For two years.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: watching him from the kitchen doorway
chars.pose: drying her hands on a cloth

panels.action: She saw it. She is not going to mention it.

dialogue.text: I saw that.
And I am going to do absolutely nothing about it, because that's what he'd want.

chars.name: kanade
chars.pose: holding up the notebook

chars.name: kou
chars.pose: closing the door

panels.action: She changes the subject by picking up the book.

dialogue.text: Next week. The rice thing you said you can't get right.
I said the numbers don't work on it.
Then we'll change them until they do.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: something very small happening at the mouth
chars.pose: taking the book from her

panels.action: The word she used.

dialogue.text: It's four cups of water and it still comes out wrong.
Then it isn't the water, and I'll prove it on Saturday.
We.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: coat on, bag over her shoulder, reluctant
chars.pose: standing in the genkan

chars.name: kou
chars.pose: standing a metre away

panels.action: Six o'clock. She has to be back before the dormitory check.

dialogue.text: Right. Dorm check at seven.
You forgot this.
I didn't forget it, I left it, which is different.
You left a hairclip on the counter too.
That one was genuinely an accident.

chars.name: kou
chars.pose: holding out the scarf

chars.name: kanade
chars.pose: winding it round her neck

panels.action: She explains her own strategy while executing it badly.

dialogue.text: If you leave something, you have a reason to come back.
You have a rota.
The rota is for cooking. This is separate.

chars.name: kanade
chars.pose: one hand on the frame, half turned back

panels.action: She stops with her hand on the frame.

dialogue.text: Hazama. Thursday.
Thursday.
And Saturday.
Hall two. Half seven. Don't be early and stand about.
I'm always early.

chars.name: kou
chars.pose: looking at her

panels.action: He confirms the rota.

dialogue.text: And Saturday.

chars.name: kanade
chars.pose: walking away down the corridor

panels.bg: apartment corridor, evening light, long shadows, flat tone field
panels.action: She goes. Solid silhouette against the lit end of the corridor.

dialogue.text: Two things a week. That's two more than I had on Monday.

chars.name: kou
chars.pose: standing in the middle of the empty room

panels.bg: apartment, four bowls stacked, low table, evening light, tone-washed
panels.action: The flat afterwards. Four bowls where there are normally two.

dialogue.text: The flat is exactly the same size as it was this morning.
It is not doing a good impression of it.

chars.name: shizu
chars.expression: flat, in the doorway with her coat on for the night shift
chars.pose: bag over one shoulder

panels.action: Shizu leaves for work at half six as she always does.

dialogue.text: The kitchen smells different.
You can't smell.
No. But there are four bowls, so I know.

chars.name: shizu
chars.pose: pausing with her hand on the door

panels.action: She says the only thing she has said about it.

dialogue.text: Kou. Don't go past ten for a while.
The layers don't wait.
No. But she'll be there on Saturday either way.

chars.name: kou
chars.pose: standing with the notebook in his hand

panels.action: He doesn't answer her, which is an answer.

dialogue.text: Thirty-three is the wall. Nobody in the building has gone past it.
We're going Thursday.

panels.bg: flat tone field, the open notebook page, one line in terrible handwriting under years of numbers, tone-washed
panels.action: The line with the letter in it.

dialogue.text: Vinegar: half again. (K.)

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: sitting up in the dark, wide awake
chars.pose: cross-legged on a dormitory bed with a notebook on her knees

panels.bg: dormitory room at night, one desk lamp, immaculate, tone-washed
panels.action: Half eleven. She has bought a notebook on the way home.

dialogue.text: It's a system. Systems are efficient. This is not a strange thing to do.
It is a slightly strange thing to do.

panels.bg: flat tone field, a new notebook page, a short handwritten list in a neat precise hand, tone-washed
panels.action: The list she has started. Four entries.

dialogue.text: Tea — grassy, bitter at the end (fault).
Balcony, 4pm — cold enough to hurt your ears.
Melon bread — sweet, crisp on top.

chars.name: riko
chars.expression: in the doorway in pyjamas, unimpressed, worried
chars.pose: arms folded

panels.action: Riko, from the door, at half eleven at night.

dialogue.text: You're writing.
I write constantly. It's most of my personality.
You're writing in a new book you bought today.

chars.name: kanade
chars.pose: hand flat on the cover

panels.action: She closes it calmly, which is the most suspicious thing she could do.

dialogue.text: Goodnight, Riko.
Goodnight, Kanade.

chars.name: riko
chars.expression: in the dark corridor afterwards, thinking
chars.pose: standing still outside the closed door

panels.action: Riko does not go to bed for a while.

dialogue.text: Two years I've managed her diary.
She has never once had a secret that made her happy.

chars.name: kou
chars.pose: walking a night street with a shopping bag

panels.bg: quiet residential street at night, vending machine glow, tone-washed
panels.action: Sunday, eleven at night. Nothing dramatic is happening.

dialogue.text: Saturdays are for stocktake and sleeping wrong.
That was true for two years. It stopped being true this morning.

chars.name: kou
chars.pose: standing in a convenience store aisle

panels.bg: convenience store interior, bright fluorescent, tone-washed
panels.action: He stops in front of the bread.

dialogue.text: Sweet. Crisp on top.

panels.bg: flat tone field, a hand picking up a packaged melon bread from a shelf, tone-washed
panels.action: He buys one. He has not bought one in two years.

dialogue.text: I still won't be able to taste it.
But I know what it's like now. Somebody told me.

chars.name: kou
chars.pose: standing outside the shop under the sign

panels.action: His phone goes. Two messages, four seconds apart.

dialogue.text: Thursday. Hall two. Half seven.
And I'm bringing the rice thing on Saturday. Don't argue.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: the smallest possible real smile, typing
chars.pose: thumb on the screen

panels.bg: night street, warm sign light, soft bokeh, tone-washed
panels.action: He answers in two words and eats the bread anyway.

dialogue.text: Yeah. Fair.
Thursday is the wall. Saturday is a rota.
I have never once had both.
